title: Tech Note: Computed Attributes in 4D
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Fully current and foundational: computed attributes remain a core, actively used ORDA feature in 4D today, and this note's explanation of get/set/query/orderBy functions on {Table}Entity classes still matches current 4D class/ORDA documentation.
related_updates: ORDA (introduced v17) and classes (introduced v18R3) are both now standard, mature parts of 4D; computed attributes built on them remain unchanged in concept and API since this note.
No successor feature has replaced computed attributes — they are still the recommended way to expose calculated/derived values as queryable, sortable entity attributes.
